answer: Counterfactual Pairing Quota. Each identity must maintain a public fable of past pairings with distinct partners; new pairings are weighted by how often those partners pair elsewhere, forming a divergence spiral that flags closed clusters. A registration only activates once its pairing history diverges below threshold, so attackers must fund many genuinely independent identities. Cost: sustained diverse interaction across the tide of new accounts, not a one-time payment.
